name: Palm Gold
description: Fermented palm wine sold in single-serve pouches. Sweet, mildly alcoholic, and popular in Old Harbor and Tier 1-2 neighborhoods. Not regulated as alcohol because it's under 4%.
flavor_profile: Sweet, yeasty, with a slight coconut note and a gentle warmth, cloudy white appearance
cultural_context: Palm Gold is the cheapest way to catch a mild buzz in the Gray Zone. It's consumed openly, sold everywhere, and considered more of a food than a drink. Grandmothers drink it. Children are not supposed to but do.
story_hooks: Coastal Spirits is trying to get Palm Gold classified as a food product to avoid alcohol taxes — the regulatory battle is a proxy war between corporate interests.
